title: Extracellular ATP drives pancreatic cancer cell invasion via purinergic receptor-integrin interactions
authors: Bort ET; Joseph MD; Wang Q; Carter EP; Roth NJ; Gibson J; Samadi A; Kocher HM; Simoncelli S; McCormick PJ; Grose RP
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胰腺癌细胞侵袭中P2Y2受体与整合素的蛋白-蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) is a cancer of unmet clinical need. Given the elevated ATP levels seen in PDAC, the purinergic axis represents an attractive therapeutic target. Mediated in part by highly druggable extracellular proteins, it plays essential roles in fibrosis, inflammation response and immune function. We have analysed the PDAC purinome using publicly available databases to discern which members may impact patient survival. We identified P2RY2 to be the purinergic gene with the strongest association to hypoxia, the highest cancer cell specific expression and the strongest impact on overall survival. Invasion assays using a 3D spheroid model revealed P2Y 2 to be critical in facilitating invasion driven by extracellular ATP. Using genetic modification or pharmacological strategies we identify the mechanism of this ATP-driven invasion to require direct protein-protein interactions between P2Y 2 and αV integrins. Using DNA-PAINT super-resolution fluorescence microscopy, we found that P2Y 2 regulates the amount and distribution of integrin αV in the plasma membrane. This work highlights a novel GPCR-integrin interaction in cancer invasion and its potential for therapeutic targeting.
abstract_zh: 胰腺导管腺癌（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, PDAC）是一种临床需求未得到满足的癌症。鉴于PDAC中观察到的ATP水平升高，嘌呤能轴代表了一个有吸引力的治疗靶点。部分由高度可成药（druggable）的胞外蛋白介导，它在纤维化、炎症反应和免疫功能中发挥重要作用。我们利用公开可用的数据库分析了PDAC嘌呤组（purinome），以辨别哪些成员可能影响患者生存。我们鉴定出P2RY2是与缺氧关联最强、癌细胞特异性表达最高且对总生存期影响最大的嘌呤能基因。使用3D球体模型的侵袭实验揭示，P2Y2在促进由胞外ATP驱动的侵袭中至关重要。通过遗传修饰或药理学策略，我们确定这种ATP驱动的侵袭机制需要P2Y2与αV整合素之间的直接蛋白-蛋白相互作用。利用DNA-PAINT超分辨荧光显微镜，我们发现P2Y2调节质膜中整合素αV的数量和分布。这项工作突显了癌症侵袭中一种新型GPCR-整合素相互作用及其治疗靶向潜力。
